title: A1 / Portable Document for posted workers — FR→DE
fact_text: If the employee stays employed by the French employer and is posted temporarily to Germany (generally up to 24 months), a Portable Document A1 issued in France keeps them in the French social-security system and exempts them from German contributions for that period.
source_name: Your Europe (European Commission) — posting staff abroad / PD A1
